edit_policy.json_format: strict JSON, two-space indentation, deterministic key order where practical

bus_contract.multiword_rule: multiword live values use snapshot or commit; independent low/high live transfer is invalid

source_mode.name: BRAM_REPLAY
source_mode.description: BRAM replay source used for signoff and controlled bring-up.

spec_mode.name: SPEC_DISABLED
spec_mode.description: Do not generate spectrum packets even when SPEC_EN is set.

spec_mode.description: Generate SPEC64 packets when SPEC_EN is set.

spec_mode.name: SPEC129

registers.name: ID
registers.description: Numeric little-endian CSR value 0x54524350. Software compares the numeric value, not raw ASCII bytes.

registers.name: VERSION
registers.description: Transport version packed as VERSION[31:16]=major and VERSION[15:0]=minor. Step 14 appends the explicitly supported command/replay CSR extension as minor 8 while retaining major 1 compatibility.

registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Control register containing persistent levels and write-one pulses.

fields.name: telemetry_enable
fields.description: Persistent level. 1 enables telemetry writer scheduling after ring configuration.

fields.name: telemetry_soft_reset
fields.description: Write-one pulse. Resets telemetry formatter, packet FIFOs, writer FSM, and transport counters.
fields.write_semantics: write 1 generates one pulse; write 0 has no effect

fields.name: clear_metrics
fields.description: Write-one pulse. Requests core metric clear at a safe boundary.
fields.write_semantics: write 1 generates one pulse; write 0 has no effect

fields.name: reserved_3
fields.description: Reserved in Revision G. Sticky flags are cleared only by CLEAR_STICKY_FLAGS.

fields.name: ring_writer_enable
fields.description: Persistent level. Enables DDR ring writes after ring configuration is accepted.

fields.name: reserved_31_5
fields.description: Reserved. Write zero; ignore on read unless a later revision assigns bits.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Live transport state bits.

fields.name: telemetry_enabled
fields.description: Active telemetry-enable state.

fields.name: ring_writer_enabled
fields.description: Active DDR ring-writer enable state.

fields.name: ring_configured
fields.description: Ring base and size have been committed and accepted.

fields.name: writer_busy
fields.description: DDR writer is actively writing, waiting, or committing a record.

fields.name: core_alive
fields.description: Core/sample activity heartbeat.

fields.name: malformed_config
fields.description: Current ring/control configuration is malformed or not accepted.

fields.name: ring_full
fields.description: Ring has insufficient free space for at least one scheduled telemetry record.

fields.name: packet_fifo_full
fields.description: Telemetry packet FIFO has reached or recently reached full condition.

fields.name: thr2_commit_pending
fields.description: THR2 commit is pending safe-frame application.

fields.name: source_commit_pending
fields.description: A source-mode request is pending safe application or the requested source mode has not yet become the actual source-mux selection.

fields.name: actual_source_mode
fields.description: Actual source-mux selection using the source_mode enumeration. This is active readback, not the requested shadow value.

fields.name: transport_epoch_idle
fields.description: The DDR writer is idle and no telemetry packet is queued for DDR, so a transport command may perform an idle-only operation.

fields.name: source_transition_busy
fields.description: A source discontinuity, source-adapter reset, or safe-boundary source transition is in progress.

fields.name: reserved_31_14
fields.description: Reserved. Shall read as zero unless assigned by a later compatible minor revision.

registers.name: THR2_LO
registers.description: Shadow threshold bits [31:0].
registers.write_semantics: write low word of THR2 shadow

registers.name: THR2_HI
registers.description: Shadow threshold bits [55:32] in bits [23:0]; upper bits [31:24] shall be zero.
registers.write_semantics: write high word of THR2 shadow; reject or flag nonzero upper bits

registers.name: THR2_COMMIT
registers.description: Writing 1 requests active threshold update at the next frame boundary.
registers.write_semantics: write one pulse; active THR2 updates only at safe frame boundary

registers.name: PACKET_ENABLE
registers.description: Packet-enable bitmask. Spectrum format is selected by SPEC_MODE, not by separate SPEC packet enables.

fields.name: WAVE_EN
fields.description: Enable WAVE telemetry packets.

fields.name: SPEC_EN
fields.description: Enable spectrum telemetry. SPEC_MODE selects SPEC64 or SPEC129.

fields.name: METRICS_EN
fields.description: Enable METRICS telemetry packets.

fields.name: STATUS_EN
fields.description: Enable STATUS telemetry packets.

fields.name: PEAKS_EN
fields.description: Reserved-disabled in Revision G. Commands setting this bit are rejected unless an extension freezes PEAKS.

fields.name: DEBUG_EN
fields.description: Reserved-disabled in Revision G. Commands setting this bit are rejected unless an extension freezes DEBUG.

fields.name: reserved_31_6
fields.description: Reserved. Commands setting these bits are rejected.

registers.name: WAVE_DECIM
registers.description: Waveform sample decimation factor. Active value is reported as WAVE.stride.

registers.name: SPEC_MODE
registers.description: Spectrum selector: 0 disabled, 1 SPEC64, 2 SPEC129. Other values are illegal.

registers.name: SPEC_SHIFT
registers.description: Unsigned right shift before clamping mag2 to uint16_t spectrum display values.

registers.name: SOURCE_MODE_SHADOW
registers.description: Shadow source mode: 0 BRAM replay, 1 ADC live, 2 audio wrapper, 3 diagnostic source.

registers.name: SOURCE_MODE_COMMIT
registers.description: Writing 1 requests atomic source-mode update under the source-mode change rule.
registers.write_semantics: write one pulse; FPGA applies only at safe sample/frame boundary and resets affected state

registers.name: RING_BASE_LO
registers.description: FPGA-visible DDR ring base address bits [31:0].

registers.name: RING_BASE_HI
registers.description: FPGA-visible DDR ring base address bits [63:32], if used by the bridge.

registers.name: RING_SIZE_BYTES
registers.description: Ring size in bytes. Must be power of two, multiple of 64, and at least 1 MiB.

registers.name: RING_CONFIG_COMMIT
registers.description: Latches ring base/size into the writer when telemetry is disabled. Resets producer pointer W to zero on accepted commit.
registers.write_semantics: write one pulse; accepted only while telemetry disabled

registers.name: RING_WR_SNAPSHOT
registers.description: HPS writes 1 to request an atomic snapshot of the FPGA-owned producer pointer.

registers.name: RING_WR_LO_SNAP
registers.description: Latched producer pointer bits [31:0]. Stable until next RING_WR_SNAPSHOT.

registers.name: RING_WR_HI_SNAP
registers.description: Latched producer pointer bits [63:32]. Stable until next RING_WR_SNAPSHOT.

registers.name: RING_RD_LO_SHADOW
registers.description: HPS-owned consumer pointer shadow bits [31:0].

registers.name: RING_RD_HI_SHADOW
registers.description: HPS-owned consumer pointer shadow bits [63:32].

registers.name: RING_RD_COMMIT
registers.description: Writing 1 makes the shadow consumer pointer visible to the FPGA writer through a CDC-safe commit.
registers.write_semantics: write one pulse; do not consume independent low/high updates

registers.name: DMA_DROP_COUNT
registers.description: Number of telemetry records dropped by the FPGA DDR writer after writer scheduling/free-space acceptance stage.

registers.name: DMA_PACKET_COUNT
registers.description: Number of normal telemetry records committed to DDR.

registers.name: DMA_STATUS
registers.description: DDR writer status bits.

fields.name: writer_idle
fields.description: DDR writer FSM is idle.

fields.name: writer_busy

fields.name: no_space

fields.name: malformed_config
fields.description: Base, size, or alignment configuration is invalid.

fields.name: ring_full

fields.name: packet_fifo_full
fields.description: Packet FIFO full condition is active or was recently observed.

fields.name: ddr_wait
fields.description: Writer is blocked by DDR/Avalon waitrequest or equivalent bus backpressure.

fields.name: drop_active
fields.description: A record is currently being dropped or was dropped in the current service interval.

fields.name: reserved_31_8
fields.description: Reserved. Shall read as zero unless assigned by a later revision.

registers.name: CORE_COUNT_SNAPSHOT
registers.description: HPS writes 1 to latch coherent sample and frame counters into snapshot registers.

registers.name: FRAME_COUNT_SNAP_LO
registers.description: Latched STFT frame count bits [31:0].

registers.name: FRAME_COUNT_SNAP_HI
registers.description: Latched STFT frame count bits [63:32].

registers.name: OVERFLOW_FLAGS
registers.description: Sticky overflow/error/status flags.

fields.name: arithmetic_overflow
fields.description: Core arithmetic overflow or unexpected internal range violation observed.

fields.name: ola_overflow
fields.description: OLA accumulator overflow or saturation-risk condition observed.

fields.name: ring_overflow
fields.description: Ring occupancy rule was violated or would have been violated without dropping.

fields.name: packet_fifo_overflow
fields.description: Packet FIFO overflow/drop condition occurred.

fields.name: malformed_packet
fields.description: Malformed DDR record or packet header observed.

fields.name: illegal_command

fields.name: cdc_error

fields.name: threshold_range_error

fields.name: source_mode_error

fields.name: oversized_record
fields.description: Record exceeded Revision G UDP size bound or packet-type maximum.

fields.name: reserved_31_10
fields.description: Reserved. Reads zero. Writes to CLEAR_STICKY_FLAGS reserved bits have no effect.

registers.name: CLEAR_STICKY_FLAGS
registers.description: Write-one-to-clear mask using the same bit map as OVERFLOW_FLAGS. Reserved-bit writes have no effect.

fields.description: Core arithmetic overflow or unexpected internal range violation observed.

fields.name: ola_overflow
fields.description: OLA accumulator overflow or saturation-risk condition observed.

registers.write_semantics: write 1 clears matching sticky flag bit; write 0 leaves bit unchanged

registers.name: CSR_COMMAND_REJECT_COUNT
registers.description: Number of command or state-change requests rejected by FPGA/CSR safety logic after HPS validation.

registers.name: PACKET_FIFO_DROP_COUNT
registers.description: Pre-writer telemetry tap or packet-FIFO drop count. Distinct from DMA_DROP_COUNT.

registers.name: COUNTER_CLEAR
registers.description: Step-14 write-one-pulse control for clearing FPGA-owned transport diagnostic counters without resetting active transport state.

fields.name: transport_counters
fields.description: Clear DMA_DROP_COUNT, DMA_PACKET_COUNT, CSR_COMMAND_REJECT_COUNT, and PACKET_FIFO_DROP_COUNT. Preserve producer W, consumer Rd, normal telemetry sequence state, core sample/frame counters, ring configuration, control levels, sticky flags, and replay state.
fields.write_semantics: write 1 emits one clear pulse; write 0 has no effect

fields.name: reserved_31_1
fields.description: Reserved. Software shall write zero.

registers.write_semantics: Only bit 0 is legal. Counter clear is diagnostic-only and shall not reset or reconfigure the transport.

registers.name: REPLAY_CONTROL
registers.description: Step-14 replay command pulses routed through the existing BRAM-replay request, admission, and retained-result authority.

fields.name: start
fields.description: Issue one raw BRAM-replay start request. The request shall pass through the existing Step-11 admission logic and shall never bypass readiness checks.
fields.write_semantics: write 1 emits one raw start-request pulse; acceptance or rejection is retained in REPLAY_STATUS

fields.name: rearm
fields.description: Rearm a quiescent failed replay epoch and clear its retained replay result state while preserving committed transport W, Rd, packet sequence, ring configuration, and transport counters.
fields.write_semantics: write 1 emits one replay-only rearm pulse; software waits for start_ready before a later start write

fields.name: reserved_31_2
fields.description: Reserved. Software shall write zero.

registers.write_semantics: START and REARM are separate write-one-pulse operations and shall not be asserted in the same CSR write.

registers.name: REPLAY_STATUS
registers.description: Live and retained BRAM-replay command/result state. HPS snapshots result_epoch before START and waits for a modulo-2^16 epoch change with exactly one retained terminal result.

fields.name: pending
fields.description: A raw START request has been captured and its admission decision has not yet been retained.

fields.name: last_accept
fields.description: Retained terminal result for the most recently decided START request was accepted. Mutually exclusive with last_reject.

fields.name: last_reject
fields.description: Retained terminal result for the most recently decided START request was rejected by replay admission. Mutually exclusive with last_accept.

fields.name: start_ready
fields.description: Current Step-11 replay admission prerequisites are satisfied for a new raw START request.

fields.name: replay_active
fields.description: The BRAM replay source is actively presenting its input or required zero-tail tokens.

fields.name: replay_path_busy
fields.description: The source-through-core replay path epoch is in progress.

fields.name: replay_path_done
fields.description: Retained Step-11 source-through-core path completion evidence for the current or most recent accepted epoch.

fields.name: e2e_busy
fields.description: The stronger replay-through-telemetry-to-DDR completion epoch is in progress.

fields.name: e2e_done
fields.description: Retained Step-11 end-to-end replay completion evidence for the current or most recent accepted epoch.

fields.name: error
fields.description: A replay source, core-path, admission, telemetry, or end-to-end error is retained for the current or most recent replay epoch.

fields.name: rearm_required
fields.description: A failed accepted replay epoch is latched and blocks restart until REPLAY_CONTROL.rearm or reset succeeds.

fields.name: reserved_15_11
fields.description: Reserved. Shall read as zero.

fields.name: result_epoch
fields.description: Modulo-2^16 terminal START-decision epoch. Increment exactly once when a captured START becomes last_accept or last_reject; do not increment on REARM.

registers.name: PLATFORM_CONTROL
registers.description: Kernel platform driver owns bit0 codec_fpga_grant. Assert only after acquiring GPIO48 output-low and confirming pin readback. Revoke before returning GPIO high. Fabric hard reset clears grant; transport/metric/source clears preserve it. Reserved bits reject writes.

fields.name: codec_fpga_grant
fields.description: Software-owned codec-bus grant reported through the fabric CSR path. Zero blocks FPGA codec initialization and live audio admission.

fields.name: reserved_31_1

registers.name: PLATFORM_CAPABILITY

multiword_transactions.name: THR2
multiword_transactions.apply_rule: active value changes only at frame boundary

multiword_transactions.name: RING_WR_POINTER
multiword_transactions.apply_rule: snapshot registers stable until next snapshot

multiword_transactions.name: RING_RD_POINTER
multiword_transactions.apply_rule: FPGA consumes committed value through CDC-safe handshake

multiword_transactions.name: CORE_COUNTERS
multiword_transactions.apply_rule: snapshot registers stable until next snapshot

multiword_transactions.name: SOURCE_HEALTH
sequence: read SOURCE_HEALTH_STATUS through SOURCE_HEALTH_TIMEOUT_EVENTS_HI from the stable snapshot
multiword_transactions.apply_rule: All 31 snapshot words latch together and remain stable until the next snapshot or hard reset. Rearm is a separate W1P write, accepted only for an actual live source with no source transition; it invalidates the source epoch without changing transport ownership. Snapshot readers serialize access.

validation_rules: All CSR offsets are 32-bit aligned and unique.
Reserved write fields shall be written as zero by software and ignored or rejected as specified.
Threshold high word bits [31:24] shall be zero for Revision G baseline.
PACKET_ENABLE reserved bits, PEAKS_EN, and DEBUG_EN are rejected in Revision G baseline commands.
SPEC_SHIFT values above 55 are illegal for baseline Wmag2=56.
Ring base/size commit is accepted only while telemetry is disabled.
No 64-bit pointer or counter is transferred by independent live low/high halves.
STATUS.actual_source_mode reports the active source mux; source_commit_pending remains set while a request is pending or requested and actual modes differ.

COUNTER_CLEAR.transport_counters clears only the four FPGA transport diagnostic counters and preserves W, Rd, telemetry sequence state, core counts, active configuration, control levels, sticky flags, and replay state.
REPLAY_CONTROL.start and REPLAY_CONTROL.rearm are separate W1P requests and shall not be asserted in the same write.
Every captured replay START reaches the existing admission owner and terminates exactly once as last_accept or last_reject with one modulo-2^16 result_epoch increment.
HPS replay command completion requires pending=0, result_epoch changed from its pre-START snapshot, and exactly one of last_accept or last_reject asserted.
SOURCE_HEALTH_CONTROL.snapshot and rearm shall be separate writes; setting both or any reserved bit is rejected.
Source-health counters saturate at 2^64-1 and clear only on fabric reset. The source epoch increments on fault, rearm, source-mode change, or explicit datapath clear.
PLATFORM_CONTROL is owned by the kernel platform driver, independent of transport state; only bit0 is writable. PLATFORM_CAPABILITY must match 0x50470100 before driver grants codec ownership.
